body:
## Best stocking fillers for adults at a glance

- **Best overall:** Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K, £31.99 at Amazon
- **Best cheap:** JLab Go Air Pop+ earbuds, £14.99 at Amazon
- **Best splurge (that isn't really one):** Audible at £0.99 a month for 3 months, via Amazon
- **Best for light sleepers:** Loop Quiet 2 ear plugs, £15.95 at Amazon
- **Best under £10:** Anker 60W USB-C cable, £6.99 at Amazon

## What makes a good stocking filler for an adult?

Grown-up stockings go wrong in two ways: novelty tat that's in the bin by New Year, or a pile of chocolate. The trick is to pick small things that solve a little annoyance. A spare charging cable for the car, a power bank for the commute, ear plugs for a snoring partner or a smart plug that finally puts the Christmas lights on a timer. None of them is exciting on its own, but each gets used for months.

Think about size, too. Everything on this list fits in a stocking or a large sock. The Fire TV Stick and the earbuds come in small boxes, the cables and plugs are lighter still, and the Audible offer is a digital sign-up, so you can write it on a card and slip it in.

## How much should you spend?

Most families settle on £10 to £30 per adult stocking, split across three or four small things. Black Friday Week makes that easier this year: the JLab earbuds, Fire TV Stick HD and the Blink camera bundle are all at or near their lowest prices, so you can include one "proper" gadget and fill the rest with cheaper extras. If your budget is tighter, our [stocking fillers under £5](/guides/stocking-fillers-under-5/) has pocket-money ideas, and [Christmas gifts under £20](/guides/christmas-gifts-under-20-uk/) has more ideas at the next price up.

## Which tech is worth it?

The **Fire TV Stick 4K** is the best all-rounder at £31.99. It suits anyone with a 4K TV, or anyone whose TV's built-in apps have become slow. The **Fire TV Stick HD** at £17.99 is for a second telly in a bedroom or kitchen. Skip the 4K Max unless they have a Wi-Fi 6E router.

The **JLab Go Air Pop+** won't replace AirPods, but at £14.99 they're a good spare or gym pair. If you want something better, our [tech gifts under £50](/guides/tech-gifts-under-50-uk/) guide has pricier earbuds.

The **Blink Outdoor 4** bundle is the surprise bargain. Two cameras for £24.99 is far below the usual price, but be clear that saving video clips to the cloud needs a monthly plan. You can avoid that with a Blink Sync Module and a USB stick.

## Gifts that aren't things

An **Audible** membership is a strong stocking filler for a reader, commuter or dog walker. Audible's Black Friday offer (£0.99 a month for three months, plus a £10 bonus for eligible members) ends on 17 December. Remind them to cancel or carry on before it renews at the normal price. Many of the Amazon prices above also need Prime during Black Friday Week; if you don't have it, the [Prime free trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/amazonprime) gets you the deal price and free delivery.

## When will prices drop?

These prices are from Amazon's Black Friday Week, which runs to Cyber Monday (30 November). Amazon devices like the Fire TV Stick rarely go lower than they are now, and usually return to full price by early December. Smaller accessories (cables, plugs) bounce around by a pound or two, so there's no need to wait. For dates, see [when is Black Friday 2026](/guides/when-is-black-friday-2026-uk/). More ideas live in our [Christmas gift guides](/christmas-gifts/).

## FAQs

### What are good stocking fillers for adults under £10?

A tough USB-C cable (£6.99) or a two-pack of cables (£5.69) is the safest bet. Most people have one cable that's fraying. Pair one with a bar of good chocolate and you're done.

### What do you put in a stocking for a man?

Practical gadgets go down well: a power bank, wireless earbuds or a Fire TV Stick for the garage or bedroom TV. Our [Christmas gifts for him under £50](/guides/christmas-gifts-for-him-under-50/) has bigger ideas.

### What do you put in a stocking for a woman?

The same rule applies: small things she'll use. Ear plugs for a light sleeper, an Audible trial for a reader or a smart plug for the fairy lights. See [Christmas gifts for her under £50](/guides/christmas-gifts-for-her-under-50/) for more.

### Are these prices for Prime members only?

Some Amazon Black Friday prices need Prime. Check the product page before you pay, and use a free trial if you aren't a member.

### When should I buy stocking fillers?

Now, if you like a deal on this list. Amazon device prices like these usually end with Cyber Monday on 30 November, and stock of the cheapest gadgets can sell out before Christmas.
